title: observability: token/KV metrics + logging dashboard improvements and alert tuning
author: Ariana Patel
description: Context: Customers have asked for better token-level cost and latency breakdowns correlated with KV cache behavior and request-level logs to diagnose expensive requests. This PR adds an updated token/KV overview dashboard, enriches tracing spans with token-level markers, and tightens alert thresholds to reduce noisy SLO alerts. Motivation: reduce time-to-detect and time-to-diagnose regressions in per-token cost and KV cache effectiveness; provide ops with actionable panels and runbooks. Changes include: - Token-level cost/latency breakdown panels (P50/P90/P99) across model variants and quantization profiles - KV cache hit/miss rate panels and group-by route/model - Per-request trace correlation (trace_id -> request_id -> token-span ids) and example flamegraph panel - Structured logging fields added to inference service logs to include token_count, kv_hits, kv_misses, model_variant, and cost_estimate - Alert tuning: lowered alert threshold for token P99 latency on high-traffic routes; added a KV-miss-rate alert with a short window and a runbook link - Backfill job to populate dashboards for the last 30 days for historical baselining - Docs: updated observability runbook and dashboard walkthrough (redwood-docs) Checklist: - [x] dashboards created and reviewed - [x] metrics instrumentation added and unit-tested - [x] tracing correlation implemented and validated locally - [x] alert thresholds reviewed with SRE - [x] e2e smoke tests passing on staging - [x] docs updated Related work: Linear ENG-1245 (token observability roadmap), ENG-1302 (kv cache metrics), SUP-4521 (customer case re: noisy alerts). CI: build + unit tests + integration smoke were green after a flaky flake was fixed (see CI summary). Merge: squash and merge after approvals. Testing notes: ran dashboard smoke on staging with replayed traffic and validated KV-hit panels align with collector logs; load test on a reserved Dedicated cluster to verify no metric cardinality blowup. Rollout plan: Gradual rollout to hosted (canary region) with feature flag for dashboards; will enable alert policy after 48h of canary monitoring.
commits: Instrument inference service: emit token_count, kv_hits, kv_misses, model_variant, cost_estimate
Enrich tracing: token-span ids and request <-> trace correlation
Add KV miss-rate alert and tuning for P99 token latency
Backfill: script to compute historical token-level aggregates for last 30 days
Docs: dashboard walkthrough and runbook links

release_notes: Improved token-level observability: new token/KV dashboard, KV miss-rate alerts, tracing correlation for token spans, structured logs for token metrics, and tuned alerts to reduce noise. No breaking changes.
